item.title: Florida scientists find new genes, DNA changes linked to Alzheimer's disease
item.description: A recent study examines why Alzheimer's presents and progresses differently in individuals using advanced biological analysis to identify DNA-level changes in the brain.

item.title: Florida GOP condemns 'Nazi heaven' group chat created by Miami party official
item.description: A group chat aimed at conservative Florida college students devolved into slurs, misogyny and calls for racialized violence, according to a report from the Miami Herald.

item.title: Tampa Bay rivers no longer source for drinking water due to severe drought
item.description: Due to persistent severe drought conditions, Tampa Bay Water announced that water from rivers is no longer viable as a source for the drinking water supply in the surrounding area.

item.title: Florida man sentenced to life for 2022 double murder, rape of witness
item.description: A man was sentenced to life in prison on Thursday in the 2022 double murder of his wife and stepson and the rape of a woman who witnessed the gruesome killings.

item.title: USF experts say fake Iran images show 'war of public opinion,' use of AI as a weapon
item.description: Reports of AI generated images showing fake videos of the conflict in Iran are spreading across social media. Experts at the University of South Florida shared how to debunk those images.

item.title: Silver Alert issued for missing Largo woman with dementia
item.description: A Sliver Alert was issued Thursday for a 69-year-old woman who disappeared from Largo.

item.title: Former Tampa Bay Lightning legend suing Lakeland ice-skating arena
item.description: Former Tampa Bay Lightning legend Vincent Lecavalier is suing an ice-skating arena in Lakeland, claiming the rink still owes him $345,000 from a previous settlement.

item.title: St. Pete approves archaeological digs at Tropicana Field parking lot after possible graves detected
item.description: St. Petersburg leaders have approved archaeological digs at a parking lot near Tropicana Field after radar scans detected what could be several graves beneath the surface.

item.title: Tampa homeowner told to demolish her house before insurance company completes investigation
item.description: Better Call Behnken is getting answers for a South Tampa homeowner whose house was destroyed in a fire last month.

item.title: Hernando Co. Jan. 6 rioter pardoned by Trump cries while getting life sentence for molesting children
item.description: A Florida handyman who was sentenced on Thursday to life in prison for molesting two children had been convicted of storming the Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021, but was pardoned by President Donald Trump.
